title: GUARD (fixed in 9add6ade84) — was: `completer _all_matches _complete` never added the "all matches" entry, because the `_all_matches_end` post-hook had no port

spec.completer:
#compdef fzam

compadd -- foobar foobaz fooqux fob

observed.notes: Completion/Base/Completer/_all_matches sh:19-20 appends `_all_matches_end` to `comppostfuncs`; _main_complete sh:401-405 calls it, and it runs `compadd "$expl[@]" -C` (sh:39-40) when nmatches > 1, so zsh lists `fob foobar foobaz fooqux` as an extra match.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: main at a9add374ed (before 9add6ade84; the binary also carried other sessions' uncommitted edits), target/debug/zshrs vs the dev oracle zsh 5.9.999.3-test (~/.cache/zshrs/zsh-oracle-new), lane-5 round-2 grid cell g1_170 (command fzp, plus a compstate -x probe line). All 14 `_all_matches` cells of that grid that reach nmatches > 1 failed the same way (g1_169/170/177-180/191-193).

retired.why: router arm for `_all_matches_end`, so the name `_main_complete` sh:404 calls dispatches to the port.

controls.note: one match: nmatches is 1, sh:33 adds nothing (both shells agreed before the fix)

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)
